changelog: - **Project and file boundaries.** File ▸ New, a Template, a pasted graph, an opened file or share link, and "Delete work data" now also close the open project: the revision chip clears and the next Export starts a new lineage instead of recording the new document as a child of the old project. And a graph file whose node has no id or no position is refused at import with the message "A node in this file has no id or no position."; before, such a file (hand-made or edited outside the app) blanked the canvas and was kept by autosave, so every later start failed the same way.
